I'm now investigating potential API changes for Hadoop components and jobs, alongside testing HDFS and Hadoop tasks. I'm also planning to expose module and container IDs within runtime components for better context and metadata propagation.

**Validating Build Scripts**

I'm now focusing on consolidating the RPM and Ambari packaging scripts, with an estimated effort of 2 days for this task. My attention is also turning towards end-to-end regression testing across all updated modules, dependencies, and packaging, which I anticipate will take approximately 2.5 days.

technical_and_design_decisions: Extend RabbitMessageBus configuration to allow exception classifier patterns via bus and stream deployment properties, ensuring Kryo deserialization and MessageConversionException types default to non-retryable.

Expose module ID and container ID via standard Spring environment variables and evaluation context variables (e.g., xd.module.id, xd.container.id) accessible within custom source, processor, and sink components.

Update KafkaMessageBus mapping logic to accept consumer (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize) and producer (batchSize, batchTimeout) deployment properties and apply them dynamically during binding.
Consolidate RPM packaging and Ambari integration scripts into a single unified directory structure within the designated repository for unified releases.
assumptions: Development and testing environment is pre-configured with JDK 17+ and access to target brokers (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Hadoop).
Upgrading Spring Integration to 4.1.5, SI Kafka to 1.2.0, and Spring Hadoop to 2.2.0 introduces minimal breaking API changes that can be resolved during standard dependency migration.
Work is performed by a single developer handling end-to-end implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation.

activities.activity_description: Add high-level direct navigation links for sources, processors, sinks, and jobs to the admin dashboard landing page.
Implement configurable retryable exceptions for RabbitMessageBus via deployment properties, handle custom exception translation, and default Kryo deserialization failures to non-retryable.

activities.activity_name: Dependency Upgrades - SI, Kafka, Hadoop (U3, U4, U5)
activities.activity_description: Update project dependencies to Spring Integration 4.1.5, SI Kafka 1.2.0, and Spring Hadoop 2.2.0 GA; resolve deprecations and verify API compatibility.

activities.activity_name: Module and Container ID Logging Exposure (U6)
activities.activity_description: Expose runtime context details (module ID, container ID) to source/processor/sink components to enable standardized identifier logging.
Extend Kafka message bus properties to support consumer and producer overrides (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize, batchSize, batchTimeout) at module binding time.
Consolidate Spring XD and Ambari RPM packaging build scripts into a unified repository layout and update release build automation.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across messaging buses, batch jobs, dynamic property overrides, and packaging verification.
